canonicalization: WHJ-1: exact UTF-8 compact JSON bytes for the empty runtime_v3_episode parameter object

text_validation.identity: ASCII allowlist; 1..128 UTF-8 bytes (schema code-point and byte bounds are equivalent)
text_validation.existing_id: 1..128 UTF-8 bytes; reject U+0000..U+001F and U+007F; Rust decoder is authoritative because schema maxLength counts code points
text_validation.terminal_ref: 1..1024 UTF-8 bytes; reject U+0000..U+001F and U+007F; Rust decoder is authoritative because schema maxLength counts code points

numeric_lexical_validation.encoding: canonical unsigned decimal JSON integer token
rules: no sign, fraction, exponent, or leading zero
wire value is at most 9007199254740991; field validators may impose tighter bounds
strict Rust decoding is normative because JSON Schema integer validation is structural and does not constrain token spelling

semantic_invariants: worker_boot_id is absent only on probe requests and is a canonical UUIDv4 on every other frame
run_id, episode_id, trajectory_id, and handoff_id are pairwise distinct canonical UUIDv4 values
a terminal receipt must exactly match the enclosing frame tuple; JSON Schema cannot express this equality
identity and reference limits are UTF-8 byte limits; JSON Schema maxLength is only a code-point approximation
probe responses may report readiness but admitting must always be false

publication.transport: owner-local authenticated endpoint; protocol artifact only
